description: Vedic astrology kundli matching (horoscope matching, marriage compatibility): 36-point Ashtakoota Gun Milan with all 8 kootas and reasons, plus dosha and Manglik checks. Varna, Vashya, Tara, Yoni, Graha Maitri, Gana, Bhakoot and Nadi scored from both Moons, each with the attributes and rule behind the score, Nadi/Bhakoot dosha flags with commonly cited cancellations, and both partners' Manglik status. Boy = person_a, girl = person_b by convention. Deterministic (JPL DE440, no LLM); every result carries meta.result_sha256. Price $0.25 per call via REST POST https://astro-agent.dev/v1/vedic/gun-milan (x402 or MPP); your first 3 calls are free here.

options.description: Optional calculation settings; every default is the common Parashari convention.

ayanamsa.description: Sidereal reference (ayanamsa). Default 'lahiri' (Chitrapaksha), the Indian standard.

house_system.description: Bhava system; 'equal' puts the lagna degree mid-house.

include_outer_planets.description: Also return Uranus, Neptune and Pluto (not used in classical Jyotish).

node_type.description: Rahu/Ketu from the mean or the true (osculating) lunar node.

ambiguous_time.description: Which occurrence to use when a local time happens twice (DST fall-back).

datetime.description: Local birth date-time, ISO 8601: '1990-05-15T14:30' (local clock time at the place) or with an explicit offset '1990-05-15T14:30:00+02:00'. Alternative: 'date' + 'time'.

time.description: HH:MM or HH:MM:SS, 24 h. Omit if unknown (computed at 12:00 with a TIME_UNKNOWN warning).

time_basis.description: What the given clock time is: civil wall-clock (default), UTC, Local Mean Time, or true (apparent) solar time.

timezone.description: IANA zone, e.g. 'Asia/Kolkata'. Optional: resolved from the coordinates, with the historical offset (DST, Local Mean Time) of that date.

name: gun_milan

endpoint.description: The REST route that computed it, e.g. 'western/natal'.

deterministic.description: Always true: same input, same result.

llm_used.description: Always false: no language model is involved.

payment.description: How this call was paid: protocol ('free' or 'none'), price and the free calls remaining.

reproducibility.description: How to reproduce and check this result.

result_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical 'result'; check it with verify_result_hash.

doshas.description: Matching doshas such as Bhakoot dosha, with whether each applies and is cancelled.

kootas.description: The eight kootas (varna, vashya, tara, yoni, graha_maitri, gana, bhakoot, nadi), each with points scored, maximum and the reason.

manglik.description: Manglik status of each person and whether the pair matches on it.

person_a.description: First person: subject and natal Moon (rashi, nakshatra, pada).

person_b.description: Second person: subject and natal Moon (rashi, nakshatra, pada).

settings.description: Settings applied, plus the Ashtakoota ruleset and convention used.

total.description: Total Gun Milan score, out of 'max'.

verdict.description: Plain-language reading of the total score.

warnings.description: Notes on the input or the calculation (for example an assumed noon for an unknown birth time). Present only when there is something to say.
